shots.action: An extreme close view of a rain-beaded bus window at night. Clear droplets sit scattered across the glass, each holding a tiny, wavering reflection of neon and sodium light. One droplet swells, breaks its surface tension, and begins to run downward, gathering smaller beads into a thin, wobbling rivulet that leaves a clear trail behind it. The glass trembles faintly with the bus's motion.
shots.what_changes: Scattered beads merge and a first rivulet begins running down the glass.

subjects: blurred city lights sliding past outside
sync_sound: steady patter of rain on glass
shots.action: The camera pushes slowly toward the wet glass as the night city beyond slips past. Out-of-focus headlights, shop signs, and streetlamps stretch into long vertical smears that slide steadily from right to left behind the droplets. Rain keeps striking the pane, each impact nudging the beaded surface, while the runnels thicken and fork downward. The reflected colors ripple and stretch across the wet film.
shots.what_changes: City lights resolve into long moving streaks while the rain runnels thicken and fork.

subjects: bus window frame and rubber seal
sync_sound: rain tapping and running on glass
shots.action: The shot pulls back gently to reveal the dark rubber seal and metal frame of the bus window, with a sliver of dim bus interior along the edge. Beyond the glass the streaking city lights continue sliding past, punctuated by the occasional brighter smear of a sign. Rainwater keeps crawling down the pane in uneven lines, and the reflections of the passing lights slide across the interior trim.
shots.what_changes: The window frame and a dark interior edge enter view as the city lights keep sliding past.
